{"command": "python3 -c "
from PIL import Image, ImageFilter, ImageEnhance
import numpy as np
im = Image.open('radiograph.jpg').convert('L')
blur = im.filter(ImageFilter.GaussianBlur(18))
a=np.array(im).astype(float); b=np.array(blur).astype(float)
d=a-b; d=(d-d.min())/(d.max()-d.min())*255
d=Image.fromarray(d.astype('uint8'))
zones={
 'zRmaxmol':(400,380,900,640),
 'zLmaxmol':(1400,380,1900,640),
 'zRmanmol':(400,680,900,980),
 'zLmanmol':(1350,660,1850,980),
 'zAntmax':(1000,360,1450,620),
 'zAntman':(950,780,1400,1000),
 'zRmaxprem':(650,380,1050,640),
 'zLmaxprem':(1200,380,1600,640),
}
for n,box in zones.items():
    c=d.crop(box); c=c.resize((c.width*3,c.height*3),Image.LANCZOS)
    c=ImageEnhance.Contrast(c).enhance(1.4); c.save(f'/app/{n}.png')
print('ok')
"", "description": "Local-contrast apical zone crops"}
